name: Hanging Twisting Leg Raise
steps: Grip a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip and hang with straight arms and straight legs held together.
Brace your abs and lift both straight legs upward while rotating your hips to guide your feet toward one side of your torso.
Lower your legs slowly back to the center hanging position while preventing body swing.
Lift your legs toward the opposite side on the next repetition, alternating sides continuously.
tips: Keep your upper body square and drive the rotation through your pelvis and obliques.
Move deliberately on the descent to keep momentum out of the exercise.
